paraphrase: A woman is not a non-soul, nor incapable of liberation, nor opposed to right faith, nor non-human, nor born in a non-Ārya land, nor of an immeasurably long life, nor of extremely cruel mind, nor unable to calm delusion, nor without pure conduct, nor of impure body, nor without the highest effort — so she is not excluded from liberation.
notes: Quoted by Haribhadra in the Lalitavistarā from the lost Yāpanīya-tantra; list of negations recalled with moderate confidence.
